diff --git a/src/stmtim.for b/src/stmtim.for
index c33ee281..c8159c63 100755
--- a/src/stmtim.for
+++ b/src/stmtim.for
@@ -1,12 +1,13 @@
       subroutine stmtim(rain,stmdur,hour,wnttim,rans,
-     1                  snodpt,rnhrs,snohrs, daytmin)
+     1                  snodpt,rnhrs,snohrs, daytmin,iplane,
+     2                  obs_year,obs_sdate)
 c     +++ PURPOSE +++
 c     This subroutine handles winter storm time and duration calculations.
 c     It was originally incorporated into WINTER, but was split out
 c     by Charles R. Meyer 6/6/96 to reduce code complexity.
 c
 c     +++ ARGUMENT DECLARATIONS +++
-      integer hour,rnhrs,snohrs
+      integer hour,rnhrs,snohrs,iplane,obs_year,obs_sdate
       real    rain,stmdur,wnttim,snodpt
       real    rans, daytmin
 c
@@ -20,7 +21,7 @@ c     +++COMMON BLOCKS+++
       include  'cclim.inc'
 c
 c     +++LOCAL VARIABLES+++
-      real denwat,tmpvr3
+      real denwat,tmpvr3,active_flag,branch_code
       integer wntdur
 c
 c     +++LOCAL DEFINITIONS+++
@@ -35,6 +36,9 @@ c
       denwat = 1000.0
       hrrain(hour) = 0.0
       hrsnow(hour) = 0.0
+      wntdur = 0
+      active_flag = 0.0
+      branch_code = 0.0
 c
 c --------------------------
 c -- Winter storm time and duration calculations...
@@ -62,6 +66,7 @@ CAS
 c
 c       condtion L2
         if ((hour.ge.wnttim) .and. (hour.lt.(wnttim+wntdur))) then
+          active_flag = 1.0
 c
 c       condition L3
 CAS Switching off rain-snow partitioning based on dew point temp.
@@ -79,6 +84,7 @@ c -- In this case, we convert units of precip to meters.
 c
             hrrain(hour) = rain / wntdur
             hrsnow(hour) = 0.0
+            branch_code = 1.0
 c           if (snodpt .gt. 0.001)then
 c            krs=krs+1
 c            ras=ras+hrrain
@@ -93,6 +99,7 @@ c -- Otherwise, we're talking snowfall...
 c -- Note that 10.0 is a conversion factor from rain to snow.
             hrsnow(hour) = rain / wntdur * 10.0
             hrrain(hour) = 0.0
+            branch_code = 2.0
 c           if (snodpt .gt. 0.001)then
 c            kss=kss+1
 c            snsn=snsn+hrsnow
@@ -141,5 +148,15 @@ c
 c
       endif
 c
+      call wepp_observe('STM_RAIN_STMDUR',obs_year,obs_sdate,
+     1                  iplane,0,hour,rain,stmdur)
+      call wepp_observe('STM_WNTDUR_WNTTIM',obs_year,obs_sdate,
+     1                  iplane,0,hour,float(wntdur),wnttim)
+      call wepp_observe('STM_TEMP_RST',obs_year,obs_sdate,iplane,
+     1                  0,hour,hrtemp,rst)
+      call wepp_observe('STM_OUT_RAIN_SNOW',obs_year,obs_sdate,
+     1                  iplane,0,hour,hrrain(hour),hrsnow(hour))
+      call wepp_observe('STM_ACTIVE_BRANCH',obs_year,obs_sdate,
+     1                  iplane,0,hour,active_flag,branch_code)
       return
       end
